title: AccessKit crash when editing StandardMaterial3D
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in master[0c51ede24] and 4.5.beta5 - Not reproducible in 4.5.beta4 ### System information Godot v4.5.beta (0c51ede24) - Arch Linux # 1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:04:43 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 580.76.05) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory ### Issue description See _Steps to Reproduce_ for details. Backtrace is similar to #107024, but the way to trigger it is different. Running the editor with `--accessibility disabled` won't trigger the crash.

### Steps to reproduce 1. Create an empty 3D scene. 2. Add a `MeshInstance3D` node. 3. Assign a new StandardMaterial3D (any slot will do). 4. Click to expand the resource in the Inspector. 5. Click in the 3D viewport. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/01908f5e-5257-4774-807b-c06ec8385962 ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
